measurement.processing: Sixteen marker columns extracted from the source raw.X (log-transformed processed expression, not raw UMI counts). All 2,638 source cells retained. Values and supplied UMAP/t-SNE coordinates preserved without rounding, re-normalization, or recomputation. Source n_counts and n_genes describe the full source assay, not this marker subset.

provenance.citation: 10x Genomics, 3k PBMCs from a Healthy Donor (2016); processed PBMC3k distributed by Scanpy and cellxgene.
provenance.notes: Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chanzuckerberg/cellxgene/main/example-dataset/pbmc3k.h5ad. Source file is the Scanpy pbmc3k_processed example. Labels are the source's annotated Louvain groups, not new cell-type predictions. One donor and one sample; selected markers are for software demonstration and are not a complete transcriptome. The local sample identifier pbmc3k identifies this source sample; no donor identity is supplied.
